versions.changelog:
Initial release of geo-prospect — a CRM-lite tool for managing GEO agency prospects and clients.

- Track prospects through pipeline stages: Lead, Qualified, Proposal, Won, Lost
- Store audit history, notes, deal values, and generate visual pipeline summaries
- All data stored locally in a persistent JSON database at ~/.geo-prospects/
- Rich command set for creating, listing, auditing, and updating prospects
- Designed for easy management of the business side of GEO services
